title: AI Architect
summary: AI architects design how generative AI and machine learning fit into a company's systems: which models and cloud AI services to use, how data reaches them, and how they stay safe, monitored and affordable. They sit between business leaders and AI engineering teams, often in a consulting or platform group, and own the design rather than writing most of the code.
dailyDuties: Meet business teams to shape AI use cases
Write high-level designs for RAG, agent and ML solutions
Choose models, vector databases and cloud AI services
Review designs and code from AI engineering teams
Set guardrails, governance and cost rules for AI systems
Plan LLMOps and model monitoring with platform teams
Present solution options and estimates to clients
